method: Road-wide review using cached native aerial strips and picture-only GoPro crops. Stations refer to qa/scaffolds.json, only an imagery coordinate frame. center_knots are independently selected lane-center offsets (positive left), not GPS fits. Lane widths/offsets are visual approximations. Model bands are NOT independently surveyed boundaries. Raw annotation coordinates are preserved; derived lane anchors are recorded separately.

roads.note: Hold the westbound/right through lane; enter the right-turn pocket only during the recorded maneuver. Lap 2 is missing the movement-begin trigger: 161 (intersection exit), not the blinker at 160, is an explicitly inferred start. Pocket exists only near the west end.
Second-from-right lane from N to O; then hold rightmost after each lap's recorded lane change. Curb extensions change the road alignment; a fixed global east coordinate is not a lane.
Persistent rightmost lane after the fork lane change. Curved curb and lane divider replace straight shortcuts on 178-179 and 309-310. Construction near the upstream fork remains uncertain.

Right-side lane/pocket follows the rounded bridge curb into the Antelope turn. The lateral movement is a bounded 1.6 m taper inferred from imagery and footage, not a generic full-width lane jump. Existing low-confidence clicks are not forced onto the curb.

Trace the leftmost THROUGH lane around the entire bend, with two separately timed spatial lane changes from right to middle to left. Remain in the through lane when a median-side turn pocket opens. Includes the full curved approach to the held 330-331 stop.
Continuous southbound left lane follows the median instead of cutting into it. Lane center shifts west as the median widens before K Street; no artificial lane change is added.
Hold the eastbound left through lane, then enter the left-turn pocket during the annotated lane change. The through-lane base does not follow the pocket's raw clicks.
Northbound through lane stays right of the changing center/turn-lane markings. Follow the pavement between yellow center markings and right curb, not the median centerline.
